r19_reprobe_disclosure.void_numbers: the originally published gaps (right 91.3 mm, left 19.0 mm) were measured through a finger-joint name-resolution bug: the probe addressed finger joints by actuator names (ffa0-style, mjOBJ_JOINT -> id -1 -> all 16 writes collapsed onto the last qpos slot), corrupting every finger configuration it believed it was scoring
r19_reprobe_disclosure.verdict_after_fix: NO SOLUTION stands — the path-end arm pose still cannot reach the band with any curl set, but the corrected gap is 40-45% smaller on both sides
